from manim import *

class ConfidenceIntervalCoverage(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Confidence intervals vary; the population mean does not", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[45, 55, 1], length=8, include_numbers=True).shift(UP * 1.5)
        true_x = line.n2p(50)[0]
        mean_line = DashedLine(
            np.array([true_x, 2.1, 0]),
            np.array([true_x, -2.0, 0]),
            color=YELLOW,
        )
        mean_label = Text("fixed mean", font_size=24, color=YELLOW).next_to(mean_line, UP, buff=0.1)
        specs = [(47.5, 51.5), (49.0, 52.5), (46.5, 49.5), (48.0, 50.8), (50.2, 54.0)]
        intervals = VGroup()
        for index, (low, high) in enumerate(specs):
            y_shift = DOWN * (0.75 + index * 0.50)
            contains = low <= 50 <= high
            color = GREEN if contains else RED
            segment = Line(line.n2p(low) + y_shift, line.n2p(high) + y_shift, color=color, stroke_width=7)
            caps = VGroup(
                Line(segment.get_start() + DOWN * 0.1, segment.get_start() + UP * 0.1, color=color),
                Line(segment.get_end() + DOWN * 0.1, segment.get_end() + UP * 0.1, color=color),
            )
            label = Text(f"sample {index + 1}", font_size=18).next_to(segment, LEFT, buff=0.25)
            intervals.add(VGroup(segment, caps, label))
        legend = VGroup(
            Text("contains mean", font_size=20, color=GREEN),
            Text("misses mean", font_size=20, color=RED),
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.8).to_edge(DOWN)
        takeaway = Text(
            "Coverage describes repeated use—not a probability for this fixed mean.",
            font_size=24,
        ).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), Create(line), Create(mean_line), FadeIn(mean_label))
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(interval) for interval in intervals], lag_ratio=0.35), run_time=4)
        self.play(FadeIn(legend))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(legend, takeaway))
        self.play(Indicate(mean_label, color=YELLOW))
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

class LinearProbingCollision(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Linear probing resolves a collision by checking the next slot", font_size=33).to_edge(UP)
        rule = Text("h(k) = k mod 7", font_size=26, color=BLUE_B).next_to(title, DOWN)
        slots = VGroup(*[
            Square(side_length=0.85, color=GRAY_B) for _ in range(7)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.08).shift(DOWN * 0.25)
        indices = VGroup(*[
            Text(str(index), font_size=20).next_to(slot, DOWN, buff=0.12)
            for index, slot in enumerate(slots)
        ])
        keys = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(
                RoundedRectangle(width=1.0, height=0.55, corner_radius=0.1, color=TEAL_B),
                Text(str(value), font_size=24),
            )
            for value in (18, 25, 32)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5).shift(UP * 1.25)
        captions = [
            Text("18 hashes to slot 4", font_size=24),
            Text("25 also hashes to 4: occupied, so probe slot 5", font_size=24),
            Text("32 probes 4, then 5, and lands in slot 6", font_size=24),
        ]
        for caption in captions:
            caption.to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), FadeIn(rule), Create(slots), FadeIn(indices), FadeIn(keys))
        stored = []
        first = Text("18", font_size=24).move_to(slots[4])
        self.play(FadeIn(captions[0]), TransformFromCopy(keys[0], first), Circumscribe(slots[4]))
        stored.append(first)

        second = Text("25", font_size=24).move_to(slots[5])
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(captions[0], captions[1]), Indicate(slots[4], color=RED))
        self.play(TransformFromCopy(keys[1], second), Circumscribe(slots[5]))
        stored.append(second)

        third = Text("32", font_size=24).move_to(slots[6])
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(captions[1], captions[2]))
        self.play(Indicate(slots[4], color=RED), Indicate(slots[5], color=RED))
        self.play(TransformFromCopy(keys[2], third), Circumscribe(slots[6]))
        lookup = Text("Lookup repeats this same probe sequence.", font_size=25, color=YELLOW).to_edge(DOWN)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(captions[2], lookup))
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[Indicate(slots[index], color=YELLOW) for index in (4, 5, 6)], lag_ratio=0.4))
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

class FeedbackErrorShrinks(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Negative feedback acts on the error", font_size=38).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 10, 1], length=9, include_numbers=True).shift(DOWN * 0.2)
        setpoint = 8.0
        tracker = ValueTracker(2.0)
        target_mark = Triangle(color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=1).scale(0.18).rotate(PI).next_to(line.n2p(setpoint), UP, buff=0.05)
        target_label = Text("setpoint", font_size=23, color=YELLOW).next_to(target_mark, UP, buff=0.1)
        output_dot = always_redraw(lambda: Dot(line.n2p(tracker.get_value()), color=BLUE_B, radius=0.12))
        error_line = always_redraw(lambda: Line(
            line.n2p(tracker.get_value()) + DOWN * 0.55,
            line.n2p(setpoint) + DOWN * 0.55,
            color=RED if abs(setpoint - tracker.get_value()) > 0.25 else GREEN,
            stroke_width=7,
        ))
        error_label = Text("error =", font_size=24).to_edge(DOWN).shift(LEFT * 0.4)
        error_number = DecimalNumber(setpoint - tracker.get_value(), num_decimal_places=1, font_size=24)
        error_number.next_to(error_label, RIGHT, buff=0.15)
        error_number.add_updater(lambda number: number.set_value(setpoint - tracker.get_value()))
        feedback_arrow = CurvedArrow(RIGHT * 3 + DOWN * 1.25, LEFT * 3 + DOWN * 1.25, angle=-TAU / 5, color=TEAL_B)
        feedback_label = Text("measure → compare → correct", font_size=23, color=TEAL_B).next_to(feedback_arrow, DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), Create(line), FadeIn(target_mark, target_label, output_dot, error_line, error_label, error_number))
        self.play(Create(feedback_arrow), FadeIn(feedback_label))
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(6.0), run_time=2)
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(7.6), run_time=1.5)
        overshoot = Text("too much correction can overshoot", font_size=23, color=ORANGE).to_edge(DOWN)
        error_number.clear_updaters()
        self.play(FadeOut(error_label, error_number), tracker.animate.set_value(8.5), FadeIn(overshoot), run_time=1.4)
        self.play(tracker.animate.set_value(8.0), run_time=1.5)
        settled = Text("settled: measured error is zero", font_size=24, color=GREEN).to_edge(DOWN)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(overshoot, settled), Indicate(target_mark, color=GREEN))
        self.wait(2)

            moving_forward.animate.shift(RIGHT * 0.5),
            moving_reverse.animate.shift(LEFT * 0.5),

            run_time=2,

from manim import *

class ConstituentSubstitution(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("A constituent behaves like one unit", font_size=38).to_edge(UP)
        words = ["The", "curious", "student", "solved", "it"]
        cards = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(
                RoundedRectangle(width=max(1.15, 0.18 * len(word) + 0.7), height=0.7, corner_radius=0.1, color=BLUE_B),
                Text(word, font_size=26),
            )
            for word in words
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.12)
        subject = VGroup(*cards[:3])
        predicate = VGroup(*cards[3:])
        brace = Brace(subject, DOWN, color=YELLOW)
        brace_label = Text("candidate noun phrase", font_size=23, color=YELLOW).next_to(brace, DOWN)
        question = Text("Can this sequence be replaced as a unit?", font_size=26).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(card) for card in cards], lag_ratio=0.15))
        self.play(GrowFromCenter(brace), FadeIn(brace_label), FadeIn(question))
        pronoun = VGroup(
            RoundedRectangle(width=1.3, height=0.7, corner_radius=0.1, color=GREEN_B),
            Text("She", font_size=26),
        ).move_to(subject.get_center())
        predicate_target = predicate.copy().next_to(pronoun, RIGHT, buff=0.12)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(brace, brace_label),
            ReplacementTransform(subject, pronoun),
            Transform(predicate, predicate_target),
            FadeOut(question),
        )
        result = Text("She solved it", font_size=30, color=GREEN_B).to_edge(DOWN)
        self.play(FadeIn(result), Circumscribe(VGroup(pronoun, predicate), color=GREEN))
        caveat = Text("Substitution supports constituency; it is not proof by itself.", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(result, caveat))
        self.wait(2)

class ClimateEnergyImbalance(Scene):

        planet = Circle(radius=1.25, color=BLUE_B, fill_color=BLUE_E, fill_opacity=0.65)
        sun = Circle(radius=0.55, color=YELLOW, fill_color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8).shift(LEFT * 5)
        sun_rays = VGroup(*[
            Line(sun.get_center() + direction * 0.7, sun.get_center() + direction * 1.0, color=YELLOW)
            for direction in (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, UL, UR, DL, DR)
        ])
        incoming = Arrow(sun.get_right(), planet.get_left(), color=YELLOW, stroke_width=8, buff=0.15)
        outgoing = Arrow(planet.get_right(), RIGHT * 5, color=RED_B, stroke_width=8, buff=0.15)

        new_balance = Text("warming raises emission until balance is restored", font_size=24, color=GREEN).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Indicate(VGroup(incoming, restored), color=GREEN))
